tabs.tab_title: Do you only do full rebrands?
tabs.tab_content: No. Sometimes the right move is a refresh: keep what customers already recognize and tighten everything around it. We’ll recommend the smallest change that solves the problem.

tabs.tab_title: Who owns the logo and brand files?
tabs.tab_content: You do. Every file, source file and guideline belongs to your business.

tabs.tab_title: Will you create ongoing content too?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Once the brand is set, our team creates photos, video, graphics and copy for your website, social and campaigns as part of your plan.

tabs.tab_title: How long does a brand project take?
tabs.tab_content: [CONFIRM] Most brand foundations are finished within the first 60 to 90 days of a partnership.

tabs.tab_title: Can I buy Branding & Content Creation on its own?
tabs.tab_content: No. Every service is delivered as part of a FirstSearch partnership, because branding & content creation works best alongside the rest of your marketing system. Your plan includes every service your business needs for one fixed monthly retainer.
